dedupe_keys.name: avp sava flood hazard maps sava river water area in the federation of bosnia and herzegovina

description: AVP Sava publishes flood hazard maps for the Sava river water area in the Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina as an ArcGIS instant app over a public feature service. The service holds areas of potential significant flood risk (68 features), flood hazard zones for the 20, 100 and 500-year floods (196, 212 and 196 features) classed by hazard level, and river sub-basins and administrative units as reference layers. Attributes follow the European reporting pattern with country, entity, river basin and flood risk management plan years (2021 in the rows read), probability, recurrence, hazard class and area. Coverage is the Sava basin in the Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina. Access is free online through the web map and the queryable feature service API. Caveats: no licence or description of methods was given in the metadata, the service allows query only with a 1,000 record page size, and data dates are empty. Simulation uses: flood exposure of water, energy and transport assets and adaptation planning. Related records: the Hrvatske vode Geoportal (data-hrvatske-vode-geoportal-flood-hazard-risk-agglomerations) and Romania ANAR flood hazard maps (data-romania-anar-flood-hazard-maps).
